key_phrases: Cloud revenues crossed the $10 billion mark
uniquely well-positioned for the AI opportunity
risk of under-investing is dramatically greater than the risk of over-investing
analysis.reasoning: The call was overwhelmingly positive, characterized by strong top-line growth in Search (14%) and Cloud (29%). Management demonstrated extremely high confidence in their AI 'full-stack' strategy and a massive commitment to CapEx ($13B in Q2), explicitly stating they prefer the risk of over-investing to missing the AI frontier. While there was a slight warning regarding Q3 margin pressure due to depreciation and infrastructure costs, the overall tone remained bullish. The QA session was direct, with management addressing sensitive topics like cookie deprecation and YouTube growth deceleration with specific operational context. Quantitative density was very high throughout the presentation.
